# Performance Optimization

**Version:** `1.0.0` · **License:** [MIT](../../LICENSE)

## Purpose

Measure, diagnose, and improve software performance.

## When it applies

This skill applies to latency, throughput, CPU, memory, allocation, I/O,
startup, artifact size, energy, cost, scalability, or performance-regression
work where comparable measurements can demonstrate the outcome.

## Capabilities

- Defines the relevant workload, requirements, and comparison method.
- Establishes a reproducible baseline before optimization.
- Uses profiling and experiments to identify real bottlenecks.
- Evaluates correctness and resource tradeoffs alongside performance.
- Verifies improvements with comparable measurements and regression gates.

## Sample prompts

- "Profile and reduce this endpoint's tail latency."
- "This job takes too long; find out where the time goes and speed it up."
- "Reduce memory usage in this data pipeline."
- "Investigate why our bundle size grew and bring it back down."
- "This query is slow at scale; diagnose and optimize it."
